description: Audio shipped with Fog of the Dragon. Only assets from the approved sources (OpenGameArt, Kenney, Pixabay) are included, and only after the license of each individual asset was checked on its own page. Every asset listed here is CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication), uploaded to OpenGameArt by its author; Kenney packs come from Kenney's own OpenGameArt uploads. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
